title: Adhyaya 5: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 5.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 5.

verses.original: योऽहिंसकानि भूतानि हिनस्त्यात्मसुखेच्छया । स जीवंश्च मृतश्चैव न क्वचित्सुखमेधते ॥
verses.transliteration: yo'hiṁsakāni bhūtāni hinastyātmasukhecchayā | sa jīvaṁśca mṛtaścaiva na kvacitsukhamedhate ||
verses.translation: He who injures harmless creatures for the sake of his own pleasure never attains happiness, neither living nor dead.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Strict ethical condemnation of cruelty and harm against innocent creatures.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: He who injures harmless creatures for the sake of his own pleasure never attains happiness, neither living nor dead.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 5: Strict ethical condemnation of cruelty and harm against innocent creatures.

verses.original: अद्भिर्गात्राणि शुध्यन्ति मनः सत्येन शुध्यति । विद्यातपोभ्यां भूतात्मा बुद्धिर्ज्ञानेन शुध्यति ॥
verses.transliteration: adbhirgātrāṇi śudhyanti manaḥ satyena śudhyati | vidyātapobhyāṁ bhūtātmā buddhirjñānena śudhyati ||
verses.translation: The physical limbs are purified by water; the mind is purified by truthfulness; the individual soul by sacred wisdom and austerity; and the intellect is purified by knowledge of Reality.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The four ascending tiers of human purification: physical, psychological, spiritual, and intellectual.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: The physical limbs are purified by water; the mind is purified by truthfulness; the individual soul by sacred wisdom and austerity; and the intellect is purified by knowledge of Reality.

layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
